editorial: As tradition clashes with empathy on the windswept isle of Berk, this sequel deepens the emotional core of the Viking-dragon mythos with masterful action and heart. Hiccup's continued journey of understanding, paired with Toothless's breathtaking physicality, creates a cinematic experience that is both thrilling and profoundly moving. It successfully manages to expand the lore without losing the intimate magic of their unlikely bond.
